description.en: Returns one of the current map's field camera settings. The map's camera settings (MAP_ENV of the current map) give RefOffsetY (height of the look-at point above the character), Dist (distance), RotH and RotV (angles, in degrees in the map data). Without them the defaults are 3.5, 130.0, 0 and 20 degrees. The angles are returned in radians.

The value (RotH and RotV in radians).
null if the name is unknown, the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Reading the map's camera distance (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
local dist = CMND_GET_CAMERA_ENV("Dist");
local height = CMND_GET_CAMERA_ENV("RefOffsetY");
